title: The Exceptional student in the class
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：exceptional　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exceptional 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the warden wrote of ① an exceptional student in the class in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② more exceptional than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the exceptional ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most exceptional student in the class anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1984 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too exceptional to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the exceptional ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an exceptional case in the record, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as exceptional as the case in the record they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was exceptional or not, and he said so.

By 1997 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something exceptional, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite exceptional; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the exceptional ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2000, for the whole place, she wrote of another exceptional student in the class in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more exceptional than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most exceptional case in the record in the whole centre, she said in 2002, was the one she could never quite name; the exceptional ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 杰出（前置定语 an exceptional student in the class：1990 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件杰出的尖子）
B. adj. 杰出／例外（比较级 more exceptional than：文中两处，一处比班上的尖子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 杰出／例外（最高级 the most exceptional：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 杰出（表语 too exceptional to do：母亲觉得它太杰出，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 例外（前置定语 an exceptional case in the record：叔叔把整件事称作一桩例外的特例）
F. adj. 例外（同级比较 as exceptional as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩记录中的特例相比）
G. adj. 例外（后置定语 something exceptional：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 例外（受程度副词修饰 quite exceptional：那位居民的评价）

items.q: an exceptional student in the class
the most exceptional student in the class anybody
an exceptional case in the record
The most exceptional case in the record in

answers.why: exceptional 意为“杰出”，1990 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件杰出的尖子”，此处作前置定语 an exceptional student in the class。
exceptional 意为“杰出”，此处用比较级 more exceptional than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
exceptional 意为“杰出”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最杰出的一件，故用最高级 the most exceptional student in the class。
exceptional 意为“杰出”，母亲认为这件东西“太杰出了，谁也用不上”，too exceptional to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
exceptional 意为“例外”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩例外的特例”，此处作前置定语 an exceptional case in the record。
exceptional 意为“例外”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩记录中的特例一样例外”，同级比较用 as exceptional as。
exceptional 意为“例外”，登记册上那半行字要的是“例外的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something exceptional。
exceptional 意为“例外”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当例外”，quite 修饰原级 exceptional。
exceptional 意为“例外”，2000 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要例外”，故用比较级 more exceptional than。
exceptional 意为“例外”，母亲 2002 年说的是“整个社区中心里最例外的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most exceptional case in the record。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件杰出的尖子。（an exceptional student in the class）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更杰出。（more exceptional than …）
母亲觉得它太杰出，谁也用不上。（too exceptional to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩例外的特例。（an exceptional case in the record）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩记录中的特例一样例外。（as exceptional as …）
到了 1997 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件例外的东西。（something exceptional）
answers: In 1990 the warden wrote of an exceptional student in the class in the register.
Everybody said it was more exceptional than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too exceptional to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an exceptional case in the record.
He said nobody would call it as exceptional as the case in the record they had once had.
By 1997 the register asked for nothing but something exceptional.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 exceptional 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the warden wrote of an exceptional student in the class in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most exceptional student in the class in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too exceptional to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an exceptional case in the record, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite exceptional, and everybody laughed.
The exceptional ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
